messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-prod cluster ded-ae-3 reporting elevated 5xx rate and p95 latency spike — tenant aureum-enterprise shows majority of errors
ryan-oncall: saw it. p95 up ~700ms, 5xx ~8% for embeddings.generate on ded-ae-3. paging SRE.
sre-lisa: joining. pulling logs now. any deploys or config changes in last 2h?
ryan-oncall: no deploys. autoscaler did scale up replicas ~30m ago but errors persisted afterwards.
eng-aaron: looking at KV cache hit rate — big increase in cold misses for shard 12 on ded-ae-3. linking metrics: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/embeddings/ded-ae-3
sre-lisa: confirmed: ded-ae-3-7 showing repeated OOMs then 502 from inference-proxy. restarting that pod now.
sre-lisa: restart done. 5xx dropped but still ~3% and some latency tails remain. doing heap profile.
ryan-oncall: CS: @cs-emily can you prepare a customer-facing, account-specific blurb for Aureum Bank (enterprise SLA)? They want tailored impact and contact routing.
cs-emily: on it. pulling account contacts: Aureum Primary: Jordan K (jordan.k@aureum.com), SRE: Alex M (+1-555-0133), EngOps: Nora P. Do we have a suggested mitigation to communicate?
sre-lisa: mitigation: route affected traffic to alternate pool ded-ae-5 and enable fallback model small-embed-v2 for latency-sensitive requests. Impact note: up to ~10% of embedding requests may see reduced vector fidelity; functional continuity should be preserved. ETA for full restore: 45–90 minutes if no regressions.
cs-emily: draft blurb for Aureum (status page / email):

```Subject: Service degradation impacting embeddings for Aureum (dedicated cluster ded-ae-3)

We are investigating an ongoing degradation affecting embeddings generation for your dedicated cluster (ded-ae-3). Symptoms: intermittent 502/5xx responses and increased latency impacting a subset of requests.

Mitigation applied: traffic is temporarily routed to an alternate replica pool with a lower-latency fallback model. Expected impact: some embedding responses may be lower precision, which could affect search/ranking quality for a small subset of queries.

Next update: within 60 minutes. Primary Aureum contacts: Jordan K, Alex M. Redwood contacts: Ryan (on-call), SRE: Lisa. For urgent escalation, we will phone Alex M.```

cs-emily: also prepping SMS/phone escalation to Alex M now. posting draft to #customer-comm for approval.
ryan-oncall: routing: if 5xx >5% for >5min, page @aureum-oncall (PD) and escalate to enterprise ops. I updated the incident-runbook link in the thread.
support-ops: status page entry created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3790012345 — initial message posted and linked the account blurb. tagging product & comms.
eng-aaron: spinning up canary to validate fallback quality vs normal embed model. will report quality delta in 15 min.
sre-lisa: heap profile shows runaway allocation in endpoint-embed worker. opening runtime bug with priority HIGH, hotfix candidate being prepared.
cs-emily: sending tailored email to Jordan/Alex/Nora with the blurb and phone escalation steps. will paste final copy in #customer-comm when sent.
support-ops: noted, will escalate to enterprise ops if SLA limits are hit.
cs-emily: Aureum acknowledged receipt: "Thanks — appreciate the fast response. Keep us updated."
sre-lisa: 37m after mitigation: 5xx at 0.9%, p95 down to baseline after cache tuning and replica redistribution. monitoring for 30m.
ryan-oncall: leaving follow-up tasks: SRE complete RCA ticket, ENG ship runtime fix in next hotfix if confirmed, CS finalize customer summary & closure note. I'll close the page if stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
sre-lisa: will post incident summary + timeline once RCA validated.
